name: RADAЯ: Experimental Session
description: A monthly concert series hosted at Bardo Projektraum featuring FLINTA artists with migrant backgrounds working in sound, performance, and sonic experimentation. Curated by Sorora e.V., the series explores noise, live coding, field recordings, voice, and hybrid compositions that challenge conventional formats. Each event offers an intimate listening experience, followed by an open conversation with the artists—placing diaspora voices and experimental practice at the center.
